_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_fe_rrip_on_mlc: the front-end-bound (instruction) marked-RRIP policy applied to the L2/MLC).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: L2 front-end-bound marked-RRIP threshold x depth sweep. --td_fe_rrip_on_mlc puts the instruction FE-bound policy on the L2/MLC: an instruction demand-fetch (MRT_IFETCH) fill whose front-end-bound fraction (fe_bound_cycles/fe_window_cycles, measured at the L1I) EXCEEDS --td_fe_rrip_thresh inserts at the fixed depth --td_fe_rrip_min_rrpv, while ALL DATA lines (and instruction prefetches) insert at basic. Fixed-min mode (no extrapolation). High-selectivity thresholds only (0.70-0.90); each threshold is run at both depth -48 and depth -64. Compare IPC / ICACHE_MISS vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L2 (default MLC_CACHE_REPL_POLICY). Every thresh_NN_dDD config puts the FE-bound instruction policy on the L2 with no extrapolation, fixed depth -DD, protecting instruction misses whose FE-bound fraction exceeds 0.NN; data lines always basic.

thresh_70_d48._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.7, depth -48.

thresh_70_d64._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.7, depth -64.

thresh_80_d48._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.8, depth -48.

thresh_80_d64._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.8, depth -64.

thresh_90_d48._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.9, depth -48.

thresh_90_d64._params: L2 FE policy, no extrapolation, threshold 0.9, depth -64.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
